lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: # MISSION.md Format

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: `MISSION.md` lives at the workspace root. It captures the _reason_ the user is learning this topic. Every teaching decision — what to teach next, which resources to surface, which exercises to design — should trace back to this document.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Template

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ```md

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: # Mission: {Topic}

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Why

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: {1-3 sentences. The concrete real-world goal the user is chasing. What changes in their life or work when they have this skill? Avoid abstract framings like "to understand X" — push for the underlying outcome.}

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Success looks like

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - {A specific, observable thing the user will be able to do}

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - {Another specific thing}

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Constraints

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - {Time, budget, prior commitments, learning preferences, anything that bounds the approach}

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Out of scope

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - {Adjacent topics the user explicitly does not want to chase right now — protects the zone of proximal development}

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Rules

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **One mission per workspace.** If the user wants to learn two unrelated things, that is two workspaces.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Concrete over abstract.** "Run a half marathon by October" beats "get fitter." "Ship a Rust CLI to my team" beats "learn Rust."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Push back on vagueness.** If the user cannot articulate why, interview them before writing anything. A bad mission is worse than no mission.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Revise when reality shifts.** Missions change. When the user's goal moves, update this file — don't leave a stale mission steering future sessions.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Keep it short.** If `MISSION.md` runs past a screen, it has stopped being a compass and started being a plan.
